name: Mohammad Wasim Shekh
title: Business Analytics · Finance · Data Science · AI
summary: I build data-driven solutions that help organizations make better business decisions. My background combines finance, business analytics, and AI—from commercial banking and financial modeling to SQL dashboards, predictive analytics, process automation, and applied machine learning. Across research, renewable energy, and financial services, I've worked on transforming complex data into actionable insights that improve operational efficiency and support strategic decision-making. This website serves as both my portfolio and knowledge hub, documenting projects in analytics, finance, AI, and business intelligence that demonstrate not only technical implementation but also the thinking behind each solution.
bio: I began my career in commercial banking, where I learned that every business decision depends on accurate data, disciplined processes, and sound financial judgment. Working with reconciliations, regulatory compliance, customer operations, and financial documentation gave me a strong understanding of how organizations manage risk and maintain operational integrity.

Wanting to combine that business foundation with modern analytical methods, I pursued an M.S. in Business Analytics at Siena University, graduating with a 4.0 GPA and Beta Gamma Sigma honors. There I developed expertise in statistics, SQL, Python, R, data visualization, predictive analytics, and AI-driven approaches for solving real business problems.

I have since applied these skills across research and industry. At the Siena Research Institute, I analyzed large-scale national survey datasets, developed automated analytical workflows, applied statistical methodologies to improve data quality, and transformed complex findings into insights used by researchers, media, and public stakeholders. At PlugPV, I contribute to business analytics, AI, and data engineering initiatives by developing SQL-driven dashboards, forecasting models, and API-based automation, while supporting the design of database schemas and data architecture for internal applications and production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and assisting with AI workflow optimization processes. Alongside my industry experience, I have conducted research on Vector-based and Knowledge Graph RAG architectures for critical document analysis, exploring approaches to improve AI reliability and reduce hallucinations in enterprise applications.

To further strengthen my finance expertise, I completed the Breaking Into Wall Street (BIWS) Core Financial Modeling program, building advanced skills in three-statement modeling, discounted cash flow (DCF) valuation, and financial analysis. Combined with my experience in analytics and AI, it reflects the direction of my career: bridging business core fundamentals, finance, data, and intelligent technologies to solve complex business problems and support better decision-making.
